digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Monday, September 14 has eight timed calendar entries, 11 carried-over items, and six urgent actions. The day turns on recovering Amazon Connect UAT from Friday's 44% close, getting a morning go or no-go on the Spanish consent, auto-answer, and skill-setup issues, and protecting tomorrow's Contigo launch readiness. Use the BD Portfolio Review and Maria 1:1 to surface portfolio and compliance impacts, but resolve coverage first: the 11:30 AM training review overlaps blocked space, and Group 4 UAT collides with both the 2:00 PM portfolio review and 3:00 PM Maria 1:1. Dashboard state was last modified Friday morning, so completion status may be stale.

items.label: Close the remaining Amazon Connect UAT blockers
items.detail: Get a Monday-morning decision on whether the unclear Spanish consent prompt and the inconsistent auto-answer and second-voice behavior require any scenarios to be held. Confirm David Lopez's skill setup and assign retest owners before the 2:00 PM Group 4 session.

items.label: Recover Amazon Connect UAT from the 44% checkpoint
items.detail: Groups 1 through 4 closed Friday at 44%, and Thiago expects at least one additional Monday session with Tuesday as a possible fallback. Protect tester attendance, keep the tracker current, and require a completion and blocker readout today.

items.label: Secure the dedicated Salesforce integration account
items.detail: Confirm whether the non-human production account will be created directly or through Halo, including permissions and monitoring, before UAT advances.

items.label: Review the Supabase security alert
items.detail: This has remained open since last week. Confirm the affected project and severity, then assign remediation or document why no immediate action is needed.

items.label: Finish the executive updates deck
items.detail: Complete the requested review and August-completions slide before the next leadership readout; use the open morning window after timecards if UAT decisions are already covered.

items.label: Close the remaining Contigo launch approvals
items.detail: Tomorrow is the planned September 15 launch. Confirm the authoritative SOP and training path, remaining document approvals, internal communication sign-off, and the knowledge record today.

items.label: Clear the pending access approvals
items.detail: Decide Sara Rodriguez's Training Agenda access and review Armando's request in help desk ticket 0033237.

items.label: Reply to Thiago's September 17 reschedule request
items.detail: Confirm whether the 1:1 can move to Thursday, September 17 while this week's UAT and launch work are arranged.

items.label: Clear Nicolas's time adjustment when it arrives
items.detail: Review the missed clock-in adjustment so payroll follow-up does not linger into the new week.

items.label: Finalize Amazon Connect direct-calling and Wave 1 scope
items.detail: Confirm client-facing use, G-28 phone details, and any additional attorney roles, then separate go-live requirements from later enhancements before rollout decisions are locked.

items.label: Confirm the Contigo Plan IVR configuration
items.detail: Check the pilot requirements with Hilary and Jhara, then confirm whether the work belongs in the current Amazon Connect scope or needs a separate owner and timeline.

items.label: 8:00-9:00 AM - Timecards and weekly setup
items.detail: Clear payroll approvals, then use the open runway before 10:30 AM for the UAT go or no-go and the most time-sensitive Contigo decisions.

items.detail: SVC standup leads into the Amazon Connect training and communications review at 11:30 AM. The review overlaps the noon blocked-space window by 30 minutes, so preserve the remaining focus time for immediate decisions.

items.label: 2:00-3:30 PM - Three-way UAT and portfolio collision
items.detail: Group 4 UAT runs through both the 2:00 PM BD Portfolio Review and the 3:00 PM Maria 1:1. Choose coverage in advance and require one consolidated UAT blocker and completion readout.

items.label: 4:30-5:00 PM - Product team introduction
items.detail: The introduction with Cory, Jorge, Jean, and Eugenia closes the visible schedule. Eugenia is out and has declined, so align on any follow-up she should receive later.

items.label: Clear the overdue Rippling task
items.detail: An unread Friday alert shows one overdue company task. Open the assignment, confirm what is still required, and complete or escalate it early today.

items.label: Confirm the operating impact of paused intakes and compliance changes
items.detail: PM leads reported that intakes remain paused while revised case-type processes await an approved, sustainable path. Get a verified status, decision owners, and communication plan before the uncertainty spreads further.

items.label: Santiago is on vacation
items.detail: Santiago remains out through Friday, so route any project coordination that depends on him to available coverage.

items.detail: Choose the priority or delegate standup coverage before Tuesday begins.
